title: Repair Windows SUSI workflow and local gate
goal: Repair the Windows workflow loop end to end: launch POSIX setup scripts through the supported shell; make changed-crate detection work with Windows Cargo metadata paths; isolate Windows APPDATA, LOCALAPPDATA, and native build caches during hermetic tests; and adapt shell-script integration-test launchers so the scoped gate can run natively. Preserve the current primary checkout and make best-effort primary sync failures nonblocking.
